msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hi! Completing your Open Water certification with your referral is a great way to finish your training in the Rosario Islands. Just to clarify: the refresher is for already-certified divers, while the mini-course is a try-dive and does not count toward your PADI certification. A refresher is normally required if it’s been more than two years since your last dive.

For two people, you’d book two places in each activity; the exact total will be shown in the booking flow.

The referral course requires an overnight stay on the islands, and accommodation isn’t included. After the referral dives, wait at least 18 hours before flying.

The referred course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; the correct plan is the Open Water Referral Course, not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Yes! For the most convenient access, I’d recommend staying at *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—both are our dive bases, and pick-up is direct.

Other nearby options with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up arrangements can vary by hotel, and accommodation is booked directly with the hotel. Would you like me to share the booking links for your diving plans once you’ve chosen your dates?

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?
reply:
Absolutely—we operate every day of the year except December 25 and January 1, weather permitting. April 5–6 sounds like a lovely plan. 🌊

Just a note: the refresher is *not $50*. Since you’ll be staying on the islands, it’s booked as *“Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)”* and costs *$134 USD per person online*. It includes the refresher session and one open-water dive; lunch isn’t included. For two people, select two places in the booking form.

Book and pay online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

The refresher is a one-day activity, so choose the date you’d like to do it before your other dives. You’ll receive the theory instructions after booking, and the medical form is required. Would you like help choosing which day to schedule it?
